title: Carol's shopping list
description: A dialogue lesson in which Carol is making a shopping list while Tom asks what they need: tea, coffee, sugar, jam, tomatoes, and meat, but no beer or wine ('And I'm not going to get any!'), ending with the joke that neither of them has much money. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions on the dialogue and sorting shop items into the correct shop columns (butcher's, greengrocer's, grocer's, newsagent's, chemist's, baker's). Grammar exercises cover fill-in with much/many/some/any/a lot of, and answering have-got questions according to the examples.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (what is Carol not going to buy) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (comprehension) 8 items are taken from the workbook key (img/key-075-080.jpg). Practice B (vocabulary shop columns) 6 items are taken from the workbook key (img/key-075-080.jpg). Grammar I (fill in with much/many/some/any/a lot of) 13 blanks are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 509). Grammar II (answer the questions according to the examples) 4 items are printed examples; items 1.b-5.f (28 answers) are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 509-510). No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. What is Carol not going to buy? 听录音，然后回答问题。卡罗尔不准备买什么？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording, then answer: What is Carol not going to buy?

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.translation: 汤姆：卡罗尔，你在干什么？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I'm making a shopping list, Tom.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我在写购物单，汤姆。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: We need a lot of things this week.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：这星期我们需要很多东西。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text:
I must go to the grocer's.
We haven't got much tea or coffee,
and we haven't got any sugar or jam.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我得去一下食品店。我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱也没有了。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text:
I must go to the greengrocer's.
We haven't got many tomatoes,
but we've got a lot of potatoes.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。我们的番茄不多了，但土豆还有不少。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text:
I must go to the butcher's, too.
We need some meat.
We haven't got any meat at all.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我还要到肉店去一下。我们需要些肉。我们一点肉也没有了。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Have we got any beer and wine?
lines.translation: 汤姆：我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text:
No, we haven't.
And I'm not going to get any!
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：没有了。不过，我不打算去买！

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: I hope that you've got some money.

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Well, I haven't got much either!

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. What is Carol not going to buy? 听录音，然后回答问题。卡罗尔不准备买什么？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue.

questions.prompt: What is Carol not going to buy?
questions.answer: She is not going to buy any beer or wine.

items.title: make a shopping list
items.text: 写一张采购物品的单子。

items.title: a lot of
items.text: 当"许多"讲，既可用在可数名词前，又能用在不可数名词前，一般用于肯定句。

items.title: We haven't got any meat at all.
items.text: 我们一点肉也没有了。at all 这个词组用在否定句中，表示"丝毫"、"一点"、"根本"的意思，有强调作用。have got 与 have（"有"）同义。

items.title: many 和 much
items.text: 均可译成"许多"，但用法不同：many 主要用于疑问句和否定句中，放在可数名词之前，如 many tomatoes；much 用于疑问句和否定句中，放在不可数名词之前，如 much tea, much money。

lesson.text:
参考译文
汤姆：卡罗尔，你在干什么？
卡罗尔：我在写购物单，汤姆。
汤姆：我们都需要什么？
卡罗尔：这星期我们需要很多东西。
卡罗尔：我得去一下食品店。我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱也没有了。
汤姆：蔬菜呢？
卡罗尔：我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。我们的番茄不多了，但土豆还有不少。
卡罗尔：我还要到肉店去一下。我们需要些肉。我们一点肉也没有了。
汤姆：我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？
卡罗尔：没有了。不过，我不打算去买！
汤姆：我希望你还有钱。
卡罗尔：我的钱不多了。
汤姆：唉，我也不多了！

practice.title: A — Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 161 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第 161 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。

questions.prompt: What is Carol doing?

practice.title: B — Vocabulary (sort items by shop)
practice.instruction:

practice.context: The key provides the completed columns with the given items and optional extras in brackets.

grammar.title: I. Fill in the blanks with "much", "many", "some", "any" or "a lot of". 用 much, many, some, any 或 a lot of 填空。
grammar.instruction: Fill in the blanks with "much", "many", "some", "any" or "a lot of". 用 much, many, some, any 或 a lot of 填空。
grammar.translation: Fill each blank with the correct word: much, many, some, any, or a lot of.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=509
grammar.context: Answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 509). Some blanks accept two forms (e.g. some/a lot of).

questions.prompt: 1. John drinks ______ coffee every day.
questions.answer: a lot of

questions.prompt: 2. I haven't got ______ time for study.
questions.answer: any

questions.prompt: 3. I have ______ black ink, but I don't have ______ blue ink at all.
questions.answer: some (a lot of)

questions.prompt: 3. I have some black ink, but I don't have ______ blue ink at all.
questions.answer: any

questions.prompt: 4. We need ______ groceries this week.
questions.answer: some

questions.prompt: 5. Are there ______ flowers in your garden in autumn?
questions.answer: any

questions.prompt: 6. There is not ______ chalk in the box on the teacher's desk. We need some.
questions.answer: much (any)

questions.prompt: 7. I bought ______ clothes in Beijing last year.
questions.answer: some (a lot of)

questions.prompt: 8. Jane doesn't know ______ people in London and she hasn't got ______ friends there.
questions.answer: many (any)

questions.prompt: 8. Jane doesn't know many people in London and she hasn't got ______ friends there.
questions.answer: many (any)

questions.prompt: 9. He borrowed ______ books from the library yesterday for the long holiday.
questions.answer: some (a lot of)

questions.prompt: 10. The old woman was poor. She did not have ______ money and often did not have ______ food to eat, but she was happy. "I have ______ friends," she said, "and I don't have ______ enemies. That is the secret of happiness. People who have ______ money often have ______ enemies, too!"
questions.answer: any / any / a lot of (some) / any / a lot of / a lot of

grammar.title: II. Answer the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句回答下列问题。

1. a. Have you got a pencil and a ruler? → I've got a pencil, but I haven't got a ruler.
2. a. Have you got any boxes and baskets? → I've got some boxes, but I haven't got any baskets.
3. a. Have you got any milk and water? → I've got some milk, but I haven't got any water.
4. a. Have you got many eggs and chickens? → I've got a lot of eggs, but I haven't got many chickens.
5. a. Have you got much paper and money? → I've got a lot of paper, but I haven't got much money.
grammar.translation: Answer each question following the example pattern for its group (some/any, a lot of/many, a lot of/much).
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=509
grammar.context: The lettered sub-questions a of each group are printed examples (not editable). The b-f answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 509-510).
